repository.scope: Metric-only elliptic-projector correction, one explicit Ricci-polynomial candidate, tests, observed outputs, and verdict. Unrelated pre-existing worktree files are excluded.

command: Run test_metric_only_elliptic_projector_gate_2026.py, metric_only_elliptic_projector_gate_2026.py, test_ricci_polynomial_projector_gate_2026.py, and ricci_polynomial_projector_gate_2026.py with Python 3.9.6 and SymPy 1.14.0.

mathematics.assertion_tested: Whether regular metric-only covariance universally forbids a rank-three elliptic auxiliary operator, and whether a concrete Ricci-polynomial rank-changing projector supplies the requested nondynamical MOND source without extra modes or a separate-matter Ward violation.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic Lorentz tensors and PB matrices; fixed spatial Fourier mode k; timelike covector V where stated; isotropic Ricci eigenvalues (-3d,d,d,d); arbitrary diagonal anisotropic tracefree Ricci eigenvalues; nonzero elliptic coefficient branch analyzed separately from its zero-field limit.
mathematics.conventions: Mostly-plus metric; h^{mu nu}=g^{mu nu}+u^mu u^nu for a normalized timelike frame; S=Ricci-(R/4)I; P=(3/4 tr(S^2))I-S^2; auxiliary action lambda(P^{mu nu} nabla_mu nabla_nu chi-J)+U(chi).
inputs: Lorentz-invariant exact-Minkowski tensor ansatz H^{mu nu}=A eta^{mu nu}+B delta_0^mu delta_0^nu
Smooth covector construction H^{mu nu}=(-V^2)g^{mu nu}+V^mu V^nu
Bare and potential-completed auxiliary multiplier actions
exact_results: At exact Minkowski without extra structure, Lorentz invariance allows H=B eta or zero and not a nonzero rank-three value.
The smooth covector tensor H=(-V^2)g+VV is an explicit rank-three counterexample for timelike V and vanishes smoothly as V tends to zero.
Its fixed-mode auxiliary PB determinant scales as f^4 k^8 while inverse response scales as 1/f, so the zero-field limit is a constraint-rank bifurcation rather than a universal nonexistence theorem.
The covariant FLRW contraction h^{mu nu} nabla_mu nabla_nu chi contains -3H chi_dot; the earlier flat-toy J_0=0 condition is not a general FLRW obstruction.
For isotropic tracefree Ricci eigenvalues (-3d,d,d,d), P has eigenvalues (0,8d^2,8d^2,8d^2).
Any diagonal spatial Ricci anisotropy produces nonzero P^0_0 equal to one quarter of the sum of squared eigenvalue differences, activating the auxiliary velocity Hessian.

The reduced Bianchi-I Ostrogradsky Dirac chain has one primary and one secondary second-class constraint, four shear-sector configuration modes rather than the two baseline shears, and a Hamiltonian linear in Ostrogradsky momenta.

A bare multiplier has lambda=0 on the invertible elliptic branch and supplies no effective stress; a direct J[g,T(g,psi)] term modifies the ordinary matter Euler equation and its separate Ward identity.

closed_subclasses: the explicit polynomial Ricci projector P=(3/4 tr(S^2))I-S^2 with the displayed ordinary auxiliary localization
a bare linear multiplier on an invertible self-adjoint elliptic branch as a source of nonzero auxiliary stress

non_claims: No universal no-go is claimed for nonanalytic exact spectral projectors.
No full perturbation analysis is inferred from the reduced Bianchi-I principal sector.
The smooth covector counterexample does not itself provide a metric-only construction unless V is supplied covariantly from the metric without adding a state.
No complete relativistic MOND action or PPN solution is claimed.

literature.search_method: No new literature theorem is used by these algebraic calculations; earlier repository citations were treated only as context.
literature.scope_result: This manifest certifies only the computations in its listed outputs and makes no novelty claim.

verification.test_status: Both self-running test programs and both main gate programs exited 0.

checks: Solve the Lorentz-stabilizer tensor equations at exact Minkowski.
Construct the smooth timelike-covector projector and calculate its eigenvalues, determinant scaling, and zero-field response.
Run the fixed-mode auxiliary Dirac chain separately for k=0 and k!=0.
Contract the covariant spatial projector on homogeneous FLRW and retain its connection term.
Construct the Ricci polynomial on isotropic and anisotropic eigenvalues.
Derive the Bianchi-I acceleration Hessian and reduced Ostrogradsky constraint chain.
Vary the auxiliary fields and distinguish a metric-only source from a direct matter-dependent source.
result: CORRECTION PLUS SCOPED NO-GO. A regular rank-changing projector is not excluded in general. The explicit polynomial Ricci realization is dead because anisotropy activates higher-derivative auxiliary modes; the nonanalytic metric-spectral branch remains open.
next_unavoidable_calculation: Freeze a candidate exact spectral projector and metric-only baryon source in one nonlinear action, then derive its full ADM Hessian, Dirac chain, independent weak-field potentials, Ward identity, FLRW branch, and stability.
residual_risks: The exact spectral projector is nonanalytic at eigenvalue degeneracy and has not been defined globally.
Rank-changing zero-field limits can be strongly coupled even when the tensor is smooth.
The reduced anisotropic calculation is a kill for the displayed Ricci polynomial, not every curvature construction.
